FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 110
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/15/2024
Senate Bill 110 as introduced could decrease potential and anticipated ad valorem tax receipts
collected on Class II and Class III property to the following funds by the estimated annual
amounts listed by capping the growth in the assessed value of Class II and Class III properties by
5% and 3% respectively, of the assessed value of the previous year's assessed value, pursuant to
the provisions of this bill.
